atoms.text: Florence Nightingale was born on 12th May 1820, in Florence, Italy. During the Crimean War, she made it her mission to improve hygiene and living standards by organising care for soldiers and training nurses in Constantinople. She famously became known as the 'Lady with the Lamp'.
atoms.sound: Florence Nightingale was born on 12th May 1820, in Florence, Italy. During the Crimean War, she made it her mission to improve hygiene and living standards by organising care for soldiers and training nurses in Constantinople. She famously became known as the 'Lady with the Lamp'.

hint.text:
The Crimean War was a war fought from 1853-1856, in which the Ottoman Empire, France, the United Kingdom and Piedmont-Sardinia formed an alliance to defeat Russia.

Constantinople was the largest city in Europe and is known today as Istanbul.
hint.label: Glossary

atoms.text: After the Crimean War, she established a nursing school at St Thomas’ Hospital in London. The importance of her work after the war to establish women’s nursing as a profession, and to increase the number of women in the workforce, is not to be underestimated. Thanks to Florence Nightingale’s devotion, nursing has become the esteemed career it is today.
